findings.description: The separator condition is reversed, changing existing help output for options with secondary spellings.
findings.rationale: For a boolean option declared as `--foo/--no-foo`, `any_prefix_is_slash` is false, so the new method displays `--foo; --no-foo` instead of `--foo / --no-foo`. Options using slash prefixes likewise receive ` / ` where the previous implementation used `; `, regressing the help formatting during extraction.
